scope: Read-only pinned client/server source contract inspection; no runtime reproduction, source mutation or test execution. Narrow native HAR ownership candidate remains frozen v5.
finding: Owner currently treats any nil from bound BrowserContext.Close as durable writer-joined proof. Pinned Go client returns nil for IsClosed, including closing, before export/wait. Server-driven browserClosed aborts tracing and does not call tracing.flush. Nil alone cannot distinguish owned normal close from an already closing/closed context.
limits: No executed late-writer reproduction yet; production keeps context private and routes known close initiators through the owner. Do not assert every browser crash leaves a pending raw writer.

guard_options: Reject preclosed state before any owned SDK Close, with observable ownership-unproven error and retained lease. A pre-entry IsClosed check alone does not fully prove against a server-close race between check and client guard. A typed SDK close outcome/owned completion acknowledgment is stronger; current exported SDK has no such receipt. Valid raw parsing, page/context close events, or dropped lease cannot replace physical writer completion.
